title: Pan-Seared Fish with Butter and Pasta
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish, served with a side of buttery pasta. Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Fish (4-6 fillets)
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild-flavored fish like cod or tilapia

ingredients.name: Quick-cooking pasta
ingredients.notes: Choose a German-style pasta like spätzle or egg noodles

instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the butter until coated.
Serve the pan-seared fish on top of the buttery pasta.
